title: System Programmer
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2514), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: Tell us about a time you improved an existing program so it ran faster or used fewer resources. What did you change?
questions.source: eMASCO 2514, task 2: Menyemak, membaik pulih atau mengembangkan program sedia ada untuk meningkatkan kecekapan operasi atau menyesuaikannya dengan keperluan baharu.

questions.text: Describe how you would test a program that runs in the background, such as a service or a scheduled job.
questions.source: eMASCO 2514, task 3: Menjalankan percubaan runs dan aplikasi perisian untuk mengesahkan ia akan menghasilkan maklumat yang dikehendaki.

questions.text: Tell us about a problem with a process or tool your team used. How did you raise it and what changed?
questions.source: eMASCO 2514, task 5: Mengenal pasti dan membincangkan masalah teknikal, proses dan penyelesaian.
